caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug in the shape of a standing man dressed in historical military attire. The jug is colored in shades of beige and light brown, with slightly darker edges and lines to depict shadows and depth. The figure wears a large three-cornered hat and a detailed uniform coat, with one hand tucked into the coat front and the other resting by the side. The face is round and expressionless, and the overall body is rounded, merging seamlessly into the handle of the jug at the back. There is a faint cross-shaped badge on the chest area of the coat. The jug base is oval and matches the overall color scheme. The drawing is signed "Ray Moon" in the lower right corner. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the ceramic jug as the central object.
title: Napoleon Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
